name: Alvin
text: Alvin is the English form of the Irish name that belongs to the Hill of Allen. The word comes from the set of names that MacKillop gives for the hill. He directs the reader to the entry for the Hill of Allen for the full account.

attributes.attribute: English form of the Irish name of the Hill of Allen
